    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]

    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)

    outer_color = grid[r0][c0]
    inner_color = next(grid[r][c] for r, c in pts if grid[r][c] != outer_color)
    inner_pts = [(r, c) for r, c in pts if grid[r][c] == inner_color]
    ir0, ir1 = min(r for r, c in inner_pts), max(r for r, c in inner_pts)
    ic0, ic1 = min(c for r, c in inner_pts), max(c for r, c in inner_pts)

    # Expand by the thickness of the outer frame; a one-cell mark expands one cell.
    dr = ir0 - r0 if ir0 != ir1 else 1
    dc = ic0 - c0 if ic0 != ic1 else 1

            if not (r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1):
